browser_mode: Playwright Chromium headless with SwiftShader; full atlas, bloom, close-up and eye views

checks: full physical body moves while asynchronous neural solves run
default actual worker reports settled or failed outcomes without learner or pilot
pause revokes power and rejects an in-flight worker reply
reset holds the declared initial condition while loading a fresh worker
motor-off mode falls under passive physics with zero active commands
legacy comparison is explicit; learner and stale worker errors cannot survive a mode change
queued replies cannot power past physics or survive a missed deadline
strict renderer has no idle behavioral motion; powered wings follow body phase

limitations: Browser rendering is software GPU emulation; timings do not predict native GPU performance.
Actual connectome replies in the motion window were all late and correctly discarded. Motion was passive falling, not controlled flight.
The queued-command test deliberately uses a synthetic motor packet to test admission timing, not acquired neural competence.
